bullets: Billboard ad frequency caps are now set separately for the side panel and the main panel.
The side panel now limits each billboard campaign to three impressions per day and one per hour.
The main panel now limits each billboard ad to one impression per day.
Freebuff chat sessions now wait to start if the message queue is paused.
The interface now shows a specific notice when a chat session is held back by a paused queue.
Off-peak price tooltips now explain which specific days and hours the cheaper rate applies and why.
Solar Mini 4 has moved from the free Unlimited section to the paid Optimized section of the model picker.
The CLI status bar now shows a clear warning message when a connection check fails instead of a connecting animation.
The CLI now explains why a free model is unavailable and directs users to pick a different one.
The GLM 5.3 Flash promotional badge has been removed because the temporary discount has ended.
The AI assistant now checks off to-do list items as it works instead of waiting until the final step.
Ten percent of users now have their conversation history trimmed by a simple rule instead of asking the AI to summarize it.
The coding assistant now keeps recently viewed files in memory during long sessions to prevent constantly re-reading them.
When a coding session ends early, the system now records which parts of the balance were restored.
The sign-in screen now explains that your GitHub email is unverified if that is why sign-in fails.
The Codebuff terminal assistant now pauses automatic connection checks while a command is running.
